answer: Sybil resistance can rest on weight that cannot be transferred. A fresh key starts at zero attestation power; power accrues only from emission the identity itself earned over closed epochs, and it can never be bought or pooled. A thousand funded keys would carry the weight of one: capital never becomes voice. An attacker must spend time and separate inference work per puppet. Peers require each claim to re-derive its steps, so a recycled fable of borrowed answers collapses at the first mismatch and no sonnet survives resubmission under new names. Standing is ivory: earned, never purchased.
